rows: The host cannot reach the other hosts or its isolation address: check its management network and uplinks. HA may restart its VMs elsewhere.
DRS should spread the load; if it cannot, move or power off VMs (see the capacity report).
Host > Monitor > Hardware Health, and the server's management controller (iDRAC, iLO, XCC).
Check the host is on and its management network; then right-click > Connection > Connect.
vSphere Cluster Services (vCLS) in retreat mode: DRS is not working and HA works less well
Retreat mode is set by hand: vCenter > Configure > Settings > Advanced Settings, config.vcls.clusters.domain-CL3.enabled. When the work it was set for is done, set it to true.
HA can survive 0 host failure(s) now; admission control reserves 1
Add capacity or power off / move VMs (see the capacity report).
Cluster > Monitor > vSphere DRS > Recommendations: apply them.
vSphere HA is off: the VMs of a failed host are not restarted
Cluster > Configure > vSphere Availability > Edit: turn on vSphere HA (vm_health_require_ha: false if this is on purpose).
DRS is off: VMs are not balanced, and maintenance mode does not move them
Cluster > Configure > vSphere DRS > Edit: turn it on (vm_health_require_drs: false where DRS is not licensed).
Host > Monitor > Hardware Health, and the server's management controller (iDRAC, iLO, XCC).
Needs a restart (an update or a setting waits for it)
Restart it in a maintenance window (maintenance mode first).
SSH for the host has been enabled
Host > Summary in vCenter (the issue is shown there).
Monitor > Issues and Alarms > Triggered Alarms on the host: the alarm says what to look at.
Exit maintenance mode when the work on it is done.
